newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot natgas recovers on storage refills.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot natgas recovers on storage refills.

text.p: Canadian spot natgas prices recovered slightly Tuesday following a few days of softening as buyers replenished parched storage facilities, industry sources said.
Spot gas at the AECO storage hub was quoted at C$1.65-1.70 per gigajoule (GJ), with the higher-priced deals done this afternoon. These prices were up about two cents from Monday.

An estimated 800 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of gas was injected into storage on Monday, a Calgary-based trader said, adding an average rate of 800 mmcf per day was needed to refill storage in time for the withdrawal season.
